title: Stevie Wonder - Superstition live on Sesame Street
summary: Stevie Wonder performs 'Superstition' on Sesame Street in 1973, with kids dancing along. It is a feel-good live music performance.
why: Recommended in Sesame Street and children's TV threads as a favorite example of the show's funkier past.

quote.text: Stevie Wonder playing Superstition on Sesame Street might be my favorite
